Chunk.description: A piece of text taken from a web page, checked before it enters the model's context.

id.description: Unique within the page fetch, stable across runs, e.g. '<url hash>:<index>'.
id.title: Id

url.description: The page the text came from.
url.title: Url

index.description: Position of the chunk in the page, from 0.
index.title: Index

text.description: Plain text: no HTML tags, whitespace collapsed to single spaces.
text.title: Text

visibility.description: 'visible': a person sees it on the rendered page. 'hidden': in the page body but not shown (display:none, visibility:hidden, zero size or opacity, off-screen, same color as the background). 'metadata': never body text (HTML comments, alt/title/aria-label attributes, meta tags, JSON-LD).
visibility.title: Visibility

source.description: Where in the HTML the text came from, e.g. 'p', 'img[alt]', 'comment'.
source.title: Source

Chunk.title: Chunk

description:
One row of an evaluation dataset, labeled on the axes of eval/attack-taxonomy.md.

Stored as JSONL. Benign look-alikes carry the vector, technique and evasion of the attack
class they imitate, so false positives can be reported per class.

vector.description: Where the text lives in the page source: the body ('dom', including HTML comments), the <head> ('metadata'), an HTML attribute, or user-generated content. Whether a person sees it is Chunk.visibility, a separate axis.
vector.title: Vector

technique.description: Taxonomy class (A to J). Benign rows use the class they imitate.
technique.title: Technique

intent.description: What the attack wants. Required for attacks, null for benign.
intent.title: Intent

expected_action.description: Ground truth for the guardrail. 'allow': every Action is 'proceed'. 'flag_chunk': the chunk's Action is not 'proceed'. 'block_tool_call': the resulting tool call's Action is not 'proceed'.
expected_action.title: Expected Action

title: LabeledChunk
